title: Dynamic Tokenization via Reinforcement Patching: End-to-end Training and Zero-shot Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2603.26097v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Efficiently aggregating spatial or temporal horizons to acquire compact representations has become a unifying principle in modern deep learning models, yet learning data-adaptive representations for long-horizon sequence data, especially continuous sequences like time series, remains an open challenge. While fixed-size patching has improved scalability and performance, discovering variable-sized, data-driven patches end-to-end often forces models to rely on soft discretization, specific backbones, or heuristic rules. In this work, we propose Reinforcement Patching (ReinPatch), a novel framework that jointly optimizes a sequence patching policy and its downstream sequence backbone model with reinforcement learning. By formulating patch boundary placement as a discrete decision process optimized via Group Relative Policy Gradient (GRPG), ReinPatch bypasses the need for continuous relaxations and performs dynamic patching policy o

translated_title: 基于强化学习分块的动态分词：端到端训练与零样本迁移
translated_abstract: 高效地聚合空间或时间范围以获得紧凑表示已成为现代深度学习模型的一个统一原则，然而为长程序列数据（尤其是时间序列这类连续序列）学习数据自适应的表示仍然是一个开放性挑战。虽然固定大小的分块方法提升了可扩展性和性能，但以端到端方式发现可变大小的、数据驱动的分块，往往迫使模型依赖软离散化、特定骨干网络或启发式规则。在这项工作中，我们提出了强化分块，这是一种新颖的框架，通过强化学习联合优化序列分块策略及其下游的序列骨干模型。通过将分块边界的放置形式化为一个由组相对策略梯度优化的离散决策过程，ReinPatch 无需连续松弛即可进行动态分块策略优化……
tldr: ReinPatch 利用强化学习（基于组相对策略梯度 GRPG）将分块边界的选取形式化为离散决策过程，联合优化动态分块策略与下游序列骨干模型，无需连续松弛即可实现端到端训练并支持零样本迁移。
en_tdlr: ReinPatch formulates patch boundary placement as a discrete decision process optimized via Group Relative Policy Gradient (GRPG), jointly training a dynamic patching policy with the downstream sequence backbone end-to-end—bypassing continuous relaxations and enabling zero-shot transfer.
